title: Copy configuration independence from proof data
statement: Let $z$ be a Boolean word, $i_0,n$ natural numbers, and $x$ a Boolean word. If $h,h'$ are natural numbers with $i_0+h\le |z|$ and $i_0+h'\le |z|$, and $h=h'$, then the copy-phase configurations constructed from these data using either bound witness are equal.
